verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK and CLI with a clean interface for conversion, extraction, pipelines, and file management, and this was independently verified via a keyless runtime probe installing the SDK from PyPI and confirming a real CLI surface and auth-gated API. missing for 10: no official OpenAPI spec discoverable (404s), and no evidence of SDKs beyond Python (e.g., JS/Node) for broader AI-native ecosystem coverage.
